title: Visual Hero
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm install && npm run build'

checks.production_build: passed: TypeScript and Vite; dist/index.html exists
checks.fonts: Instrument Serif and Barlow loaded and checked at both viewports
checks.animation: video decoded; canvas frame capture and both boomerang directions verified
checks.interactions: GSAP parallax, CTA hover/press, mobile menu toggle, Escape and link selection verified

asset_issues.recovery: Related Dirtyline 36Daysoftype 2022 font recovered and archived locally; exact equivalence unverified, so not substituted.

notes: Original video bundled unchanged; MD5 matches source ETag. Google font files bundled locally alongside required import.
All page layout, text and controls are real DOM; no reference screenshot is used as the webpage.
Prompt title MicroVisuals takes precedence over reference title VisualStudio.
CTA application flows and navigation destinations are unspecified; visual interactions are implemented, with fragment navigation and no invented backend.
Software-decoded capture yielded 22 desktop and 19 mobile frames. Playback smoothness depends on decoder performance; physical devices and other browser engines untested.
Only Visual Hero was implemented. No agents, deployments, pushes, or messages were used.
